newsitem.title: USA: Mississippi Gov. signs income tax cut for couples.
newsitem.headline: Mississippi Gov. signs income tax cut for couples.

text.p: Mississippi Gov. Kirk Fordice has signed a bill that cuts state income taxes by $46 million over four years by eliminating the marriage penalty, a spokeswoman said.
Fordice signed the bill Monday. Over four years, the law phases in changes in the exemption and standard deduction rates so that married couples will pay the same rate as two single persons.

The deduction married couples receive would rise to $4,600 from $3,400 and the exemption would rise to $12,000 from $9,500 over four years. For single taxpayers, the deduction would remain $2,300 and the exemption $6,000.
